'''KapriCorp''' manufactured and marketed the best thrust packages<ref name="J10" /> and [[Acceleration compensator/Legends|inertial compensators]]<ref name="SWS" /> for use by civilians during the height of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Their thrust packages were designed to improve the performance and carrying capacity of [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]].
